title: Why does price rise when demand rises?

steps.title: The arrow is a shift
steps.say: The green arrow is not a move along D1. It shows the whole demand curve moving right to D2, because buyers want more at every price.

ops.text:
Green arrow = the whole demand curve
shifts right (more demanded at every price)

steps.title: New equilibrium
steps.say: The new demand curve D2 crosses supply at a higher price and a larger quantity.

steps.title: Price rises
steps.say: Because demand shifted right, the equilibrium price goes up from P1 to P2, and quantity rises from Q1 to Q2.

ops.text:
So price rises: P1 → P2
Quantity rises: Q1 → Q2
